title: Ownership fails at the first question
summary: The first questions of grief already loosen the claim of ownership. Receive the gift without claiming the outcome.
takeaway: Receive the gift without claiming the outcome.
lifeApplication: Before grasping harder, pause with one hand open and let refuge matter more than possession.

source.shortMeaning: The first questions of grief already loosen the claim of ownership.
source.lifeApplication: When you tighten around what is yours, ask whose it finally is.
